text:
riley: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — action items for vendor/dependency outage (cloud control-plane blips + model-registry 401s + auth throttling). Need owners and timeboxes. I'll open a tracker after this.

hannah: I'll take the model-registry auth work. Root cause: token refresher failed during KMS rotation. Short-term: cached-token fallback + alert on refresh failures. ETA 4 business days. Preventative control: pre-rotation canary.

owen: I'll own provider routing fallback and an emergency read-only mode for model-registry. Short-term ETA: routing policy + canary in 3 days; read-only mode in 7 days.

maya: I'll handle alert tagging and the monthly external-dep smoke job. First smoke run in 10 days. Also will add label external_dep=true to related alerts so the regression detector can surface patterns.

ops-bot: Created ticket EDRW-221: https://redwood.internal/incidents/EDRW-221. Owners, please add these checklist lines and set timeboxes (short-term = sprint / <=2w).

riley: Paste checklist lines to EDRW-221: - [ ] hannah — cached-token fallback + alerting — ETA 4d — preventative: pre-rotation canary; - [ ] owen — routing fallback + read-only mode — ETA 3d/7d — preventative: region-preference routing; - [ ] maya — alert tagging + monthly smoke — ETA 10d — preventative: automated smoke alerts.

hannah: Claiming model-registry item. Will post PR link to the ticket when ready.

owen: Will canary routing change at 5% -> 25% if green.

maya: Added smoke job spec to ticket and scheduled first run.

riley: Two asks before closing thread: 1) add one-line "what would have prevented this" to your checklist item, 2) include rollout/canary plan in PRs. We'll review EDRW-221 in the next ops sync. :thumbsup:
